title: TypiCore: A Hybrid Active Query Strategy for Class-Incremental Learning on Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2607.17632v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Time series data play a pivotal role across numerous domains, including healthcare and manufacturing. In real-world environments, models must cope with distribution shifts over time, a challenge commonly addressed through Continual Learning (CL) techniques. However, existing CL methods face a critical limitation: real-world data streams are rarely fully labeled, making annotation cost a major practical constraint. This paper investigates Active Class-Incremental Learning (ACIL) for multivariate time series, where a model must sequentially learn new classes while selectively querying labels under a fixed annotation budget. We present a systematic evaluation of a wide range of query strategies combined with multiple rehearsal-based approaches, assessing their impact on plasticity, stability, and label efficiency across four benchmark datasets. Our analysis reveals the limitations of uncertainty-based and distribution-aware method

translated_title: TypiCore：一种用于时间序列类增量学习的混合主动查询策略
translated_abstract: 时间序列数据在医疗健康和制造业等众多领域发挥着至关重要的作用。在真实环境中，模型必须应对随时间变化的分布偏移，这一挑战通常通过持续学习（CL）技术来解决。然而，现有CL方法面临一个关键局限：真实世界的数据流很少被完全标注，标注成本成为主要的实际制约因素。本文研究了多变量时间序列上的主动类增量学习（ACIL），模型需要在固定的标注预算下，一方面顺序地学习新类别，另一方面有选择地查询标签。我们对多种查询策略与多种基于重放的相结合进行了系统性评估，在四个基准数据集上考察了它们对可塑性、稳定性和标签效率的影响。我们的分析揭示了基于不确定性的方法和分布感知方法的局限性。
tldr: 本文提出了TypiCore——一种面向多变量时间序列主动类增量学习的混合主动查询策略，并通过在四个基准数据集上的系统性评估，揭示了现有基于不确定性和分布感知查询方法的局限，在固定标注预算下同时提升了模型的可塑性、稳定性和标签效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TypiCore, a hybrid active query strategy for active class-incremental learning on multivariate time series, which systematically evaluates query strategies combined with rehearsal-based methods across four benchmarks, revealing the limitations of uncertainty-based and distribution-aware approaches while improving plasticity, stability, and label efficiency under a fixed annotation budget.
